rules.title: It runs to length
rules.statement: Every take measures at least its planned seconds and overshoots by no more than the per-take allowance; the assembled film lands within the scaled tolerance of the target; every take decodes at the declared frame rate.

provenance.note: the only guarantee a machine can hold alone; allowances calibrated from measured Seedance jitter of 0.042-0.056s per take

rules.title: The image is clean
rules.statement: No frozen or black segments, no broken anatomy, no morphing between things, no garbled writing, no stranger who was not planned.

provenance.note: the artifact class a vision model perceives most reliably; frozen and black segments are measured, the rest is asked

rules.title: Something changes
rules.statement: The state at the end of the shot differs from the state at its start in the way the plan declared; a shot that leaves the story where it found it is decoration.

provenance.note: creator, 2026-08-31: no storytelling in the shot — every metric was green and the film was dead

rules.title: The opposition is on screen
rules.statement: The force the plan names for the shot is visible acting against the subject; pressure is shown, never narrated.

provenance.note: creator, 2026-09-04: shots are planned around subjects and the forces of antagonism

rules.title: People and places hold
rules.statement: The subject looks like its reference and the place looks like the same place across every shot that shares them; a face or a room that drifts breaks the film.

provenance.note: continuity is what references and edits exist for; judged against the reference assets the shot carried
